paper_title: Axion dark matter from topological defects
coupling_convention: x = f_a (axion decay constant) in GeV, y = m_a in eV; f_a values derived from the paper's own zero-temperature mass relation ma(0)^2 = c0*Lambda_QCD^4/Fa^2 with c0=1.46e-3, Lambda_QCD=400 MeV
notes: Theoretical/cosmological paper (Kawasaki, Saikawa, Sekiguchi 2015) computing axion CDM abundance from post-inflationary PQ breaking (misalignment + strings + string-wall systems) via field-theoretic simulations. Primary result is on the f_a-m_a plane: overclosure requires ma >= (0.8-1.3)e-4 eV for NDW=1 (equivalently Fa <~ (4.7-7.6)e10 GeV; the band reflects simulation uncertainties in xi, epsilon, A, etc.). For NDW>1, Fa <~ O(1e9-1e10) GeV with additional dependence on bias parameter Xi and phase delta (allowed only with mild tuning delta <~ O(1e-3-1e-2)); those 2D (Fa, Xi) constraints are not encoded here. Not a haloscope/DM-density-dependent search, so dm_density_assumed=null. No formal CL quoted (uncertainties are 1-sigma simulation errors); 0.95 entered as placeholder.
